QNX toolchain files set CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME to QNX (and often QNX TRUE), and QNX notes that CMake conditionals checking CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME need to be extended for QNX; decide whether QNX belongs in this condition (e.g. add `AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "QNX"` or an elseif branch).
This branch is Linux-only. qcc defines __QNX__ (value 800 for QNX 8.0; e.g. #if defined(__QNX__) && __QNX__ >= 800); add a QNX branch. __QNXNTO__ is deprecated.

findings.message: Platform branch for __CYGWIN__ has no __QNX__ case
findings.suggestion: This conditional selects code for other Unix-like systems (BSD/macOS/Solaris/AIX/HP-UX) but never for QNX. qcc defines __QNX__ (800 for QNX 8.0); check whether QNX should take this branch (add `|| defined(__QNX__)`) or the other one (add `&& !defined(__QNX__)`).
